missing_authority_instance.name: SERVICE_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY_AUTHORITY
missing_authority_instance.registry_or_resolver: none — the D15 implementation_dependency names a 'Per-service source applicability registry/resolver' and no counterpart exists in the current tree

the_upstream_authority_that_is_missing.statement: The missing thing is not an implementation of selection. It is an APPLICABILITY AUTHORITY that must be consulted BEFORE a service assembles a source set, at a grain where the service and the target use are already known.
the_upstream_authority_that_is_missing.why_upstream: D15 lists upstream_inputs as 'EmpiricalUniverse identity; service; target question/coordinate/structural use; time/geography/population scope'. Every current consumer of a source set is DOWNSTREAM of a decision nobody makes.
the_upstream_authority_that_is_missing.precise_gap: The chain currently begins at 'here is a set of sources' and validates it. It never begins at 'here is a service request; which sources apply?'

instance_level_consequences.consequence: A service cannot DERIVE its admissible sources from (target, population, geography, effective time).
instance_level_consequences.who_must_decide: an applicability authority owner, not the query layer

instance_level_consequences.consequence: A service cannot be REFUSED an inapplicable source, because inapplicability is never determined — only declared by whoever supplied the source.
A service cannot CHOOSE among multiple admissible sources or record a preference order.
No record exists of WHY a source was selected. Execution receipts record what was run, not why it was admitted.
'No applicable source' and 'an applicable source with missing internal evidence' are distinguishable only by caller assertion, because nothing computes the former.

what_would_NOT_close_the_gap: Adding a service field to EmpiricalQuerySpec. It would make the caller MORE explicit while still leaving the caller to supply the answer.

Relying on AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE or SOURCE_UNIVERSE_RELATION. Those govern relations BETWEEN admitted universes; using them to decide ADMISSION would collapse power 8 into powers 3-7, which both current law and the D15 ledger forbid.
Treating the SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE state vocabulary as the applicability function. A declared state is not a determination.
Using currentness (power 10) as a proxy for applicability. Currentness is evaluated on a supplied source.
safest_available_capability_today: A caller may assemble a source set, bind AUTHORIZED_COMPOSITE and relation authorities for whatever composition it wants, and receive fail-closed validation plus per-source receipts. That is genuine capability — it is simply validation, not authorisation of selection.
